objective: Make objective planning honor persisted append-only candidate status history so work already selected or completed is not selected again.
acceptance_criteria: When a delegation state directory is supplied, planning resolves the effective candidate register from seed candidates plus the latest persisted candidate versions, with the persisted version winning for the same candidate id.
A candidate whose latest persisted status is selected or completed fails the status_open eligibility check and cannot be selected again.
A seed candidate with no persisted version remains available exactly as before.
When no delegation state directory is supplied, existing seed-only planning behavior is unchanged.
The full plan-run path can be given an explicit state directory without launching a model solely to reconcile candidate status.
python -m company.integration check --repo-root . remains ready with all required checks passing.
constraints: Use the existing DelegationStore and CandidateRegister; do not introduce another persistence mechanism.
Do not weaken candidate eligibility checks or make non-OPEN candidates selectable.
Do not modify production simulation code, Company OS authority policy, CEO-reserved actions, or canonical main.
notes: Repository Architecture V1 Phase A follow-up from phase_a_discovery_checkpoint_02.md. The purpose is to prevent duplicate model spend on already-completed work.
